newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop puts more luxury units on offer.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop puts more luxury units on offer.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said on Wednesday it would put another 75 units, on top of a total 189 flats already on offer, in its luxury King's Park Villa residential development in Kowloon due to strong response.
A company spokeswoman said the additional units would be offered at HK$9,504 per square foot.
She also said 6,024 potential buyers have registered to buy the units by the end of a three-day registration period on Wednesday.
All the flats will go on sale on Saturday, she said.
This is the third time more flats have been offered in the development, from the original 36 units put on sale at an average price of HK$8,640 per square foot.
The development in Ho Man Tin, Kowloon, has a total floor area of 474,123 sq ft and would be completed in March 1997.

It comprises six 21-storey residential blocks providing 342 units with areas ranging from 1,109 to 1,508 sq ft, 18 duplexes with areas ranging from 2,086 to 2,465 sq ft, and a four-level car park with 360 parking spaces.
